loss_factor_definition: finite non-negative per-particle factor supplied by an external PRAiSE-compatible table keyed by selected particle ID
method: lossless synchrotron emissivity from C-HI particle endpoint rows multiplied by an external PRAiSE-compatible particle loss table
projection: 0 deg, projected along simulation y onto x-z plane
science_status: local interface product only; not a final PRAiSE science radio product
volume_assignment: declared side volumes divided evenly across selected particles
